purpose: Separate design visualizations of the proposed Rowan operating systems, not implementation screenshots.

images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / photorealistic product visualization.
Create ONE highly polished landscape 16:10 image showing exactly the proposed Rowan 98 operating system inside its charcoal SA-01 CRT monitor. Straight-on, eye-level view, extremely close crop: the complete front monitor casing fills almost the entire image, with only a tiny neutral dark margin. Focus on the actual screen and hardware. A precise design visualization, not an advertising poster. No outside headings, annotations, collage, hands, desk, stand, keyboard, plants, or extra devices.

Hardware: a bespoke widescreen vintage CRT with chunky dark CHARCOAL molded plastic, NOT beige. Rounded rectangular shell, a deep recessed black inner bezel, curved thick convex glass with dark bowed sides and a very subtle cool blue rim. Below the screen: small pale embossed “SAAD AKHTAR” branding at left and tiny “PERSONAL MONITOR SA-01” below it, a slotted speaker grille in the middle, two tactile square channel arrow keys, circular colour button, knurled brightness dial, and olive-green round power button at right. Small screws and vents; restrained authentic manufacturing detail. Soft warm studio key from upper-left, weak cool fill, realistic matte plastic roughness, tiny metal highlights and deep recess shadows. Screen light genuinely spills softly onto the adjacent inner lip: teal by teal desktop, white by bright application windows. Glass room reflections are faint enough to preserve readable content. Subtle CRT scanlines and edge RGB fringing; clear sharp central typography.

On screen: a refined authentic Windows 98-inspired desktop branded Rowan 98, teal #008080 desktop, square gray #c0c0c0 chrome, 1px raised/inset bevels, navy active window captions, small Tahoma-style typography, original pixel icons rather than Microsoft logos. Left column desktop shortcuts with readable names “Computer”, “Documents”, “Portfolio”, “Console”, “Recycle Bin”. Bottom taskbar with “Start” at left, pressed task buttons “Documents” and “Console”, sound icon and “16:19” at right.

Show a real-looking working desktop, not a wallpaper with fake UI: a gray File Explorer window titled “Documents” across center-left, menu “File  Edit  View  Help”, a folder tree and aligned file rows “Welcome.txt”, “Projects”, “Pictures”, “Sketches”. A second active window titled “Console” overlaps at center-right, gray classic frame and navy caption, black interior with clearly rendered monospace text “C:\HOME> dir”, then “Documents   Projects   Pictures”, then “C:\HOME>”. Its content must read as a normal DOS-style console, not hacker code. Small accessible minimize/maximize/close buttons on each caption. Keep enough teal visible to see desktop identity. A modest open Start menu in the lower-left lists “Programs”, “Documents”, “Settings”, “Run”, “Shut Down”.

Production finish: coherent small readable text, precisely aligned controls, convincing CGI material and local light reflections. The result should directly communicate this monitor and this OS at a glance. No neon gaming chassis, no futuristic HUD, no macOS dock, no meaningless metrics, no watermark.

Use case: ui-mockup / photorealistic product visualization.
Create ONE highly polished landscape 16:10 image showing exactly the proposed Rowan 2026 desktop operating system inside its bespoke SA-02 modern monitor. Straight-on, eye-level view, extremely close crop: the entire thin front monitor frame fills almost the image, with only a tiny neutral dark margin. Show hardware plus operating system clearly, like an impeccable front-facing product/UI render. No outside titles, annotations, mood board, collage, desk, stand, keyboard, people, plants, or extra devices.

Hardware: dramatically thin graphite anodized-aluminum bezels with softly rolled edges and modest rounded corners, 7–10px visible frame at this image scale, a slightly wider restrained lower lip with a tiny etched “SA-02” identifier and pin-sized warm power indicator. Flat, nearly flush anti-reflective glass, a hairline gasket and finely cut metallic chamfer. Photorealistic physically based materials: brushed/coated graphite, tight metal highlights, faint broad softbox reflection at upper left, subtle glass edge. The pale desktop casts a natural soft neutral glow on the inner edge; a blue artwork at the right contributes a distinctly localized subtle blue reflection to the right chamfer. Do not draw a uniform neon perimeter. Beautiful soft studio key and cool fill. Screen content is clean and razor-sharp, no CRT distortion or scanlines.

The OS is “Rowan”: an ORIGINAL 2026 minimalist personal desktop, not macOS or Windows 11. Pale mineral ground #e9e7df, warm white solid application surfaces #f7f6f0, deep ink #202722, muted sage-gray secondary text, and a very sparing warm vermilion #9d3d2b focus mark. Crisp General Sans-style typography; monospace only in Terminal. Elegant architectural composition, precisely joined surfaces, restrained depth and generous breathing room.

A slim 64px left app rail: small original Rowan mark and “Apps” at top, neatly spaced line icons with brief readable labels “Files”, “Notes”, “Work”, “Terminal”, and at bottom two workspace names “Desk”, “Studio”. One active app marker. A very thin top status line with active app “Notes” at left and sound, display icon and “16:19” at right. No bottom dock, no traffic-light controls, no glassmorphism cards or gimmicky dashboards.

Across the central workplane, show a beautifully composed joined pair of two real app windows occupying about two-thirds of the screen, leaving some quiet wallpaper visible around them: left a warm-white text editor titled “Welcome.txt — Notes”, right an image viewer titled “Light study — Preview” showing a striking still image of a cobalt-blue folded satin-painted surface. The two windows align perfectly and touch at ONE hairline shared resizing seam with a subtle handle; modest 10px outer corners and thin understated header chrome, clean independent minimize/maximize/close symbols at right, not Apple coloured buttons. Left document text, clearly readable: “Saad Akhtar”, then “A personal workspace.”, then two short rows “Documents, ideas, and things in progress.” and “Make yourself at home.” Add a tiny “Saved” document status. A short warm-ink focus segment under the Notes caption echoes the rail marker.

A compact secondary Terminal window sits below-left without covering the main document title or the shared seam, with a dark green-black content area and a warm-white caption. Clearly rendered monospace content “visitor@rowan:~$ ls”, next line “Documents  Projects  Pictures”, next prompt “visitor@rowan:~$”. This is a small everyday computer tool, not a dense sci-fi console. Keep the desktop spacious and coherent. The original wallpaper visible behind apps is a subtle close crop of pale folded architectural material with one graphite plane, not abstract gradient blobs.

Production finish: extraordinarily crisp coherent typography and alignment, realistic light response and subtle object depth, specific original identity. The picture must directly communicate this thin monitor and its sleek modern OS. No marketing text outside the monitor, no futuristic HUD or fake CPU charts, no watermark.
